RunSynchronousCommand.Path: cmd.exe /c >>X:\pe.cmd (echo:@echo off&echo:call :print ^"Setting keyboard layout for PE session^"&echo:wpeutil.exe SetKeyboardLayout 0416:00020409&echo:for ^%^%d in (C D E F G H I J K L M N O P Q T U V X Y Z^) do ()
cmd.exe /c >>X:\pe.cmd (echo:if exist ^%^%d:\sources\install.wim set ^"IMAGE_FILE=^%^%d:\sources\install.wim^"&echo:if exist ^%^%d:\sources\install.esd set ^"IMAGE_FILE=^%^%d:\sources\install.esd^")

cmd.exe /c >>X:\pe.cmd (echo:if exist ^%^%d:\sources\install.swm set ^"IMAGE_FILE=^%^%d:\sources\install.swm^" ^& set ^"SWM_PARAM=/SWMFile:^%^%d:\sources\install*.swm^"&echo:if exist ^%^%d:\autounattend.xml set ^"XML_FILE=^%^%d:\autounattend.xml^")
cmd.exe /c >>X:\pe.cmd (echo:if exist ^%^%d:\$OEM$ set ^"OEM_FOLDER=^%^%d:\$OEM$^"&echo:if exist ^%^%d:\$WinPEDriver$ set ^"PEDRIVERS_FOLDER=^%^%d:\$WinPEDriver$^"&echo:^))
cmd.exe /c >>X:\pe.cmd (echo:for /f ^"tokens=3^" ^%^%t in ('reg.exe query HKLM\System\Setup /v UnattendFile 2^^^>nul'^) do ( if exist ^%^%t set ^"XML_FILE=^%^%t^" ^))

cmd.exe /c >>X:\pe.cmd (echo:if not defined IMAGE_FILE call :fail ^"Could not locate install.wim, install.esd or install.swm.^"&echo:if not defined XML_FILE call :fail ^"Could not locate autounattend.xml.^"&echo:set ^"OS_VERSION=11^")

cmd.exe /c >>X:\pe.cmd (echo:for /f ^"tokens=3 delims=.^" ^%^%v in ('ver'^) do (&echo:if ^%^%v LSS 20000 set ^"OS_VERSION=10^"&echo:^)&echo:if defined PEDRIVERS_FOLDER (&echo:call :print ^"Loading drivers from $WinPEDriver$ folder^")

cmd.exe /c >>X:\pe.cmd (echo:for /R ^%PEDRIVERS_FOLDER^% ^%^%f IN (*.inf^) do drvload.exe ^"^%^%f^"&echo:^)&echo:^>X:\diskpart.txt (&echo:echo:SELECT DISK=0&echo:echo:CLEAN&echo:echo:CONVERT GPT&echo:echo:CREATE PARTITION EFI SIZE=300)

cmd.exe /c >>X:\pe.cmd (echo:echo:FORMAT QUICK FS=FAT32 LABEL=^^^"System^^^"&echo:echo:ASSIGN LETTER=S&echo:echo:CREATE PARTITION MSR SIZE=16&echo:echo:CREATE PARTITION PRIMARY&echo:echo:SHRINK MINIMUM=1000)

cmd.exe /c >>X:\pe.cmd (echo:echo:FORMAT QUICK FS=NTFS LABEL=^^^"Windows^^^"&echo:echo:ASSIGN LETTER=W&echo:echo:CREATE PARTITION PRIMARY&echo:echo:FORMAT QUICK FS=NTFS LABEL=^^^"Recovery^^^"&echo:echo:ASSIGN LETTER=R)

cmd.exe /c >>X:\pe.cmd (echo:echo:SET ID=^^^"de94bba4-06d1-4d40-a16a-bfd50179d6ac^^^"&echo:echo:GPT ATTRIBUTES=0x8000000000000001&echo:^)&echo:call :print ^"diskpart will now partition and format your disk^")

cmd.exe /c >>X:\pe.cmd (echo:diskpart.exe /s X:\diskpart.txt ^|^| call :fail ^"diskpart.exe encountered an error.^"&echo:set ^"IMG_PARAM=/Name:^"Windows ^%OS_VERSION^% Pro^"^"&echo:call :print ^"Applying Windows image to target disk^")

cmd.exe /c >>X:\pe.cmd (echo:dism.exe /Apply-Image /ImageFile:^%IMAGE_FILE^% ^%SWM_PARAM^% ^%IMG_PARAM^% /ApplyDir:W:\ /CheckIntegrity /Verify ^|^| call :fail ^"dism.exe encountered an error.^"&echo:call :print ^"Making system partition bootable^")

cmd.exe /c >>X:\pe.cmd (echo:bcdboot.exe W:\Windows /s S: ^|^| call :fail ^"bcdboot.exe encountered an error.^"&echo:bcdedit.exe /set {fwbootmgr} bootsequence {bootmgr}&echo:call :print ^"Copying answer file to target disk^"&echo:mkdir W:\Windows\Panther)
cmd.exe /c >>X:\pe.cmd (echo:copy ^%XML_FILE^% W:\Windows\Panther\unattend.xml&echo:if defined PEDRIVERS_FOLDER (&echo:call :print ^"Adding drivers from $WinPEDriver$ folder to new installation^")

cmd.exe /c >>X:\pe.cmd (echo:dism.exe /Add-Driver /Image:W:\ /Driver:^"^%PEDRIVERS_FOLDER^%^" /Recurse&echo:^)&echo:call :print ^"Setting time zone^"&echo:dism.exe /Image:W:\ /Set-TimeZone:^"E. South America Standard Time^")
cmd.exe /c >>X:\pe.cmd (echo:call :print ^"Disabling Windows Defender^"&echo:reg.exe LOAD HKLM\mount W:\Windows\System32\config\SYSTEM)

cmd.exe /c >>X:\pe.cmd (echo:for ^%^%s in (Sense WdBoot WdFilter WdNisDrv WdNisSvc WinDefend^) do reg.exe ADD HKLM\mount\ControlSet001\Services\^%^%s /v Start /t REG_DWORD /d 4 /f&echo:reg.exe UNLOAD HKLM\mount&echo:call :print ^"Disabling WPBT^")

cmd.exe /c >>X:\pe.cmd (echo:reg.exe LOAD HKLM\mount W:\Windows\System32\config\SYSTEM&echo:reg.exe add ^"HKLM\mount\ControlSet001\Control\Session Manager^" /v DisableWpbtExecution /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f&echo:reg.exe UNLOAD HKLM\mount)
cmd.exe /c >>X:\pe.cmd (echo:call :print ^"Setting device setup region to Brazil (GeoID 32^)^"&echo:reg.exe LOAD HKLM\mount W:\Windows\System32\config\SOFTWARE)

cmd.exe /c >>X:\pe.cmd (echo:reg.exe ADD ^"HKLM\mount\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Control Panel\DeviceRegion^" /v DeviceRegion /t REG_DWORD /d 32 /f&echo:reg.exe UNLOAD HKLM\mount&echo:call :print ^"Computer will now reboot^"&echo:wpeutil.exe reboot)
cmd.exe /c >>X:\pe.cmd (echo:goto :eof&echo::fail&echo:echo:&echo:echo:Fatal error: ^%~1&echo:echo:&echo:pause&echo:exit 1&echo::print&echo:echo:&echo:echo:*** ^%~1 ***&echo:echo:&echo:goto :eof)
cmd.exe /c "X:\pe.cmd"

powershell.exe -WindowStyle "Normal" -NoProfile -Command "$xml = [xml]::new(); $xml.Load('C:\Windows\Panther\unattend.xml'); $sb = [scriptblock]::Create( $xml.unattend.Extensions.ExtractScript ); Invoke-Command -ScriptBlock $sb -ArgumentList $xml;"
powershell.exe -WindowStyle "Normal" -ExecutionPolicy "Unrestricted" -NoProfile -File "C:\Windows\Setup\Scripts\Specialize.ps1"
reg.exe load "HKU\DefaultUser" "C:\Users\Default\NTUSER.DAT"
powershell.exe -WindowStyle "Normal" -ExecutionPolicy "Unrestricted" -NoProfile -File "C:\Windows\Setup\Scripts\DefaultUser.ps1"
reg.exe unload "HKU\DefaultUser"

Extensions.File:
HKU = &H80000003 Set reg = GetObject("winmgmts://./root/default:StdRegProv") Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
If reg.EnumKey(HKU, "", sids) = 0 Then If Not IsNull(sids) Then For Each sid In sids key = sid + "\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Explorer" name = "LockedStartLayout" If reg.GetDWORDValue(HKU, key, name, existing) = 0 Then reg.SetDWORDValue HKU, key, name, 0 End If Next End If End If
